decisions_log.decision: Tooltip implemented as a 'use client' component using useId() for aria-describedby linkage, with CSS-only hover visibility (Tailwind group/group-hover:). No external tooltip library.
decisions_log.rationale: Sketch deferred the tooltip library choice and said to prioritise simplicity. Radix UI is not already in the project. A custom Tailwind-only tooltip is zero-dependency, matches the repo style, and satisfies AC2 and AC4 without adding a new dev dependency.

decisions_log.decision: Relative time formatting uses Intl.RelativeTimeFormat (built-in) rather than date-fns.
decisions_log.rationale: date-fns is not in package.json. Adding it would be a new dependency requiring a deferred-question raise per the SWE persona rules. Intl.RelativeTimeFormat is available in Node 12+ and all modern browsers, covering all the relative time units needed.

decisions_log.decision: app/changelog/page.tsx sorts entries at render time rather than relying on the JSON file order.
decisions_log.rationale: Defensive programming: the page guarantee is newest-first regardless of authoring order in the data file. This also makes the sort intent explicit in code.

decisions_log.decision: ChangelogList uses role='feed' (ARIA feed pattern) instead of a plain section.
decisions_log.rationale: The linter applied this improvement. role=feed is the ARIA landmark for a list of dynamically updating articles, which is semantically correct for a changelog.

files_changed.summary: CSS-only accessible tooltip using Tailwind group/group-hover:. Uses useId() for aria-describedby linkage and role="tooltip" for screen readers. Zinc-palette with dark: class variants.

Renders one changelog entry: title (h2), description (p), and a relative timestamp via Intl.RelativeTimeFormat wrapped in Tooltip showing the absolute date on hover. All zinc-based with dark: variants.
Container that renders a role=feed of ChangelogEntry components. Sorting responsibility is delegated to the caller (page.tsx).

Next.js server page at /changelog. Sorts changelog.json entries newest-first and renders via ChangelogList. Mirrors homepage zinc-50/bg-white outer-inner layout. Statically pre-rendered at build time.

self_assessment.notes: AC1 (changelog page, newest-first), AC2 (tooltip on hover), and AC4 (dark mode) are all covered. AC3 (RSS feed) was implemented by T1 and is not in scope for this task. All styling is strictly Tailwind-based using zinc tokens with dark: variants. No new dependencies were added. Build, lint, and all 87 tests pass (49 pre-existing + 38 new).
